rows.law: count-integrity battery (B2-441 envelope law, with B2-216 census denominator law and citation-lint PHANTOM-NUMBER as siblings)
rows.claim: Every receipt count must cite a machine tally written in the same session; hand-copied counts are invalid by law, which enacts exactly what the brief's claims 3.2 and 8.1 demanded.
rows.quote: Any wave receipt claiming a 1302 count ("zero 1302", "N x 1302") is INVALID unless it cites a provider_errors.json (or equivalent per-wave tally JSON) written in the SAME session as the wave.
rows.steal: After tonight's wave receipts land, run python tools/provider_error_tally.py --session <wave-session-id> --out <session-dir>/provider_errors.json and cite the JSON in each receipt that states a count.
rows.falsifier: A receipt claiming zero-1302 whose session dir holds no provider_errors.json (or whose tally shows nonzero network_failed_events) yet stays accepted.
